title: desktopHomeView
responsibility: Adapt the signed-in Mac workspace and its Tracker snapshot for the shared Hub Home components.

inputs.name: desktopHomeView.home
inputs.description: The Tracker projection from the Mac bridge, or null while unresolved or unavailable.

inputs.name: desktopHomeView.workspace
inputs.description: The project list, listing statuses and selection operation of the active desktop workspace.

inputs.name: desktopHomeView.settled
inputs.description: Whether the initial Tracker home read has answered.

inputs.name: desktopHomeView.now
inputs.description: Current Unix time in milliseconds, used to classify scheduled and past-due work.

outputs.name: desktopHomeView
outputs.description: Home presentation data with independent workspace and Tracker states, source notices and project navigation.
